title: Urgent lane answer
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.3 "The route", #773), not implemented. The hub's answer to `POST /api/station/urgent`. 200: `ok`, `gen` and one result per item it took; an item missing from `results` was not taken and is sent again. 400, 413, 422: `error` and `reason` (`bad_json`, `bad_batch`, `too_large`): the sender cuts the request to single items. 401, 403, 409: `error` and `reason` as on every station route (station-error.schema.json): kept and retried every 30 s. 503 with a Retry-After header: the hub is not the leader and NOTHING was applied; its body has `error` and `updating`. Only a 200 that names an item `applied`, `duplicate` or `stale` makes it sent.

gen.description: On a 200: the hub's fencing generation, a count (lease.schema.json `counter`: an integer up to 2^53 - 1, or a string of decimal digits). When it differs from the last answer's, the sender sends again every alarm it marked sent in the last 120 s.

results.description: On a 200: one entry per item taken, in any order.

error.description: On a 4xx or 5xx: a sentence for people. Fixed text, never the token.

reason.description: On a 4xx: why, as one word a program can act on. The route's own are `bad_json`, `bad_batch` and `too_large`; a refused token gets station-error.schema.json's words.

updating.description: On a 503: the hub is deploying or this task is not the leader.

result.title: One item's answer
result.description: What the hub did with one item of the request, named by its (key, rev).

status.description: `applied`: taken and acted on (an alarm raised, a page's live state set). `duplicate`: this (station, key) was already taken, by this lane or the app's; nothing new was raised. `stale`: taken, too old to act on (an alarm past the hub's age limit: a late notice, no push; a page rev below the one held). `rejected`: the hub will never take this item. The first three mean sent; a sender keeps and retries an item whose word it does not know.
